runtime.connectingBody: The Tenshu tab hosting Fit is busy. Fit will load as soon as it answers.
runtime.elsewhereTitle: Tenshu is open in another tab
runtime.elsewhereBody: Tenshu runs in one tab at a time, so your data can't get out of step. Use it here to move it to this tab.
runtime.moving: Waiting for the other tab to finish saving. This can take up to two minutes.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: This part of Fit hit an unexpected error. Your data is safe — nothing was changed.

stream.stopped: Updates stopped — what you see may be out of date.

errors.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.error_unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.error_internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.error_invalid_caller: This app is not allowed to do that.
errors.error_unannounced_session: Tenshu needs to reconnect. Please try again.
errors.error_unsupported_operation: This version does not support that yet.
errors.error_fit_bad_cursor: History lost its place. Reload it to start from the top.
errors.error_fit_bad_page_size: History couldn’t be read in pages of that size.
errors.error_fit_bad_window: That date range can’t be shown.
errors.error_fit_invalid_zone: Your browser’s time zone isn’t recognised, so days can’t be grouped.
errors.error_fit_invalid_goal: That goal is outside the allowed range.
errors.error_fit_invalid_profile_value: That value is outside the allowed range.
errors.error_fit_unsupported_format: Only GPX and TCX files can be imported.
errors.error_fit_binary_unsupported: Binary .FIT files can’t be imported on the web yet. Export the activity as GPX or TCX instead.
errors.error_fit_malformed_file: This file is damaged or isn’t a valid GPX or TCX file.
errors.error_fit_streams_unreadable: This workout’s route and heart rate can’t be read.
errors.error_fit_file_too_large: This file is too large to import (at most 32 MB).
errors.bridge: Couldn’t reach Tenshu. Make sure it is open and unlocked, then try again.
errors.bridge_timeout: Tenshu took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.bridge_not_permitted: Fit is not allowed to do that.

history.title: Workouts
history.empty: No workouts yet. Import a GPX or TCX file, or record one on your phone.

import.title: Import a workout
import.hint: GPX or TCX, up to 32 MB. The file never leaves your devices unencrypted.
import.saved: {count, plural, one {Saved # workout from {name}.} other {Saved # workouts from {name}.}}
import.pending: Saved; route and heart rate will upload when online
import.maybeSaved: Some workouts from this file may already be saved — check History. Importing it again is safe.

detail.gone: This workout no longer exists. It may have been deleted on another device.
detail.deleteBody: It is removed from all your devices. This can’t be undone.

map.noWebGL: This browser can’t draw maps (WebGL is off or unsupported).
map.notConfigured: Maps are not set up for this site.
map.noRegion: No map data for this area.

bounds.heightImperial: Enter feet and inches (0–11), at most {max}.
